numbering: Episodes numbered 1–101 (single 1993–1996 TV run, Anime Filler Guide numbering); The First Slam Dunk film is unnumbered.

arcs.name: Hanamichi Joins Shohoku
arcs.summary: Delinquent Hanamichi Sakuragi joins Shohoku High's basketball team to impress Haruko Akagi, despite knowing nothing about the sport.
events: Hanamichi falls for Haruko and challenges captain Akagi to a one-on-one.
Hanamichi joins the team and clashes with rookie star Kaede Rukawa.
Hanamichi grinds through fundamentals and learns the lay-up.

arcs.name: Practice Game vs Ryonan
arcs.summary: Shohoku plays a practice match against strong rival Ryonan and its ace Akira Sendoh.
events: Hanamichi makes his game debut but starts on the bench.
Sendoh's skill pushes Shohoku to the limit, and Ryonan wins narrowly.

arcs.name: Miyagi and Mitsui Return
arcs.summary: Point guard Ryota Miyagi returns from the hospital, and former star Hisashi Mitsui comes back as a delinquent bent on wrecking the club.
events: Mitsui's gang storms the gym to start a fight with the team.
Mitsui breaks down in front of coach Anzai and rejoins the team.

arcs.name: Prelims: Miuradai and Gohoku
arcs.summary: The Inter-High prefectural preliminaries begin with Shohoku's first official games.
events: Hanamichi makes a chaotic official debut against Miuradai.
Shohoku beats Miuradai and moves on through the bracket.

arcs.name: Prelims: Shoyo
arcs.summary: Shohoku faces seeded powerhouse Shoyo and its player-coach Fujima.
events: Mitsui's three-pointers keep Shohoku in the game.
Hanamichi dunks and Shohoku defeats Shoyo to reach the final league.

arcs.name: Final League: Kainan
arcs.summary: In the final league, Shohoku faces Kainan, the king of Kanagawa led by Shinichi Maki.
events: Akagi injures his ankle but returns to the game.
Hanamichi's late pass goes to the opponent and Shohoku loses by two.

arcs.name: Training and Kainan vs Ryonan
arcs.summary: Shohoku must win its remaining games, while Kainan and Ryonan face off.
events: Hanamichi shaves his head in contrition and trains intensely.
Maki and Sendoh duel as Kainan beats Ryonan.

arcs.name: Final League: Ryonan
arcs.summary: The deciding game for Kanagawa's last Inter-High spot is a rematch with Ryonan.
events: Uozumi and Akagi battle under the basket.
Shohoku beats Ryonan and qualifies for the Inter-High.

arcs.name: Road to the Nationals
arcs.summary: Shohoku prepares for the national Inter-High tournament.
events: Rukawa attends a national youth camp and aims for America.
Hanamichi takes on 20,000 shots of jump-shot training with Anzai.

arcs.name: Anime-Original Finale
arcs.summary: An anime-original story that ends the TV series before the national tournament.
events: Shohoku plays a practice match against a combined team of rivals.
The anime ends without adapting the Inter-High.

arcs.name: The First Slam Dunk
arcs.summary: Inoue's 2022 film retells Shohoku's Inter-High game against reigning champions Sannoh, centered on Ryota Miyagi.
events: Ryota's backstory with his late brother Sota is told alongside the game.
Shohoku defeats Sannoh in the final seconds.

filler.note: Mostly canon; filler includes episodes 34–35, 48–49, 85–86, 95 and the anime-original finale 97–101.
